name: bubble
description: Inspect and edit Bubble apps through the Bubble MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to your Bubble apps and build by describing what you want. ChatGPT can read and edit your app (pages, workflows, data types, option sets, styles, and records) and make changes the same way the Bubble editor does.

publication.release_notes: Initial release connecting the Bubble MCP server.
